baseline.known_issue: board:caption:text 22.2px at 720p; charts visually slender; title+content much of 1280x720 unused

hypothesis: Bounded compiler-owned hierarchy increases effective text-group heights and painted chart/bar area while conserving evidence-grounded semantic action timing/identities, and horizontal COMPARISON compression increases conceptual grouping without collisions.
interventions: Only opt-in V3-79 compiler profile, never mutate prior source/movie
Increase node Text typography up to CMU 30 for primary Math/Equation and label types while bounding original Manim max width=2.75, chart captions max width=2.7
Increase all CHART stroke/fill bar widths equally from 0.85 to 1.2 world; keep height proportional to host-ledger bar_value; no changes to numeric facts
Tighten horizontal COMPARISON pair centers from ±3.05 to ±2.4 world only if V3-75 exact geometry and routes accept; non-COMPARISON layouts unchanged
Keep stable node/relation/beat IDs, narration/audio content, semantic claims, all original action timings, and Indicate scale=1.07
Retain mandatory V3-75 no-intersection gate, actual Manim V3-76 SVG glyph contrast >=4.5:1, native H264 AV pixel witnesses, V3-78 independent salience measurements

gates.native: Exactly 3 new truly rendered H264/AAC clips at 1280x720 15fps, SHA and ffprobe, source/decoded-frame receipts versioned, no old artifact mutation
gates.regression: All V3-78/V3-77 negative tests PASS, plus V3-79 overlap/content budget/scene identity/font profile/semantic timing/mutation tests
gates.comparison: Report before/after source SHA, native content bbox occupancy, physical text group heights, nine decoded samples and chart structure; no invented direct pixel-perfect visual quality score
gates.quality: A better footprint/readability warning is only technical evidence; user/human review remains NOT PASS pending fresh independent assessment
gates.no_regressions: No low-contrast glyphs, collision or text clipping, no physical MP4 underruns; fail closed
gates.heldout: No topic- or node-ID-specific constants inside layout/typography implementation
